title: Decision-dependent propagation of correlated feature-estimation error in connectome-based machine learning — research code
description: Analysis code and derived per-participant summary tables for decision-level propagation of correlated feature-estimation error (circular block bootstrap and uHAC) and its evaluation on repeat brain scans from the CoRR NYU_2 site and the Transdiagnostic Connectome Project. Raw imaging data are not included; see README for the public data sources. Derived tables remain subject to the attribution terms of the source data (CC0; ODC-By v1.0). Public access is provided with copyright retained; no open-source reuse license is granted in this version.
